aiThesis.rationale:
## LLY Investment Thesis

### Summary
Eli Lilly (LLY) is the premier metabolic disease pure play, possessing a dominant duopoly position alongside Novo Nordisk. With a massive demand tailwind for Mounjaro/Zepbound and a pipeline extending into Alzheimer's, LLY is a high-conviction compounder. However, at $1213.91, the stock trades in line with our probability-weighted fair value of $1206.93, indicating no margin of safety and justifying a HOLD.

### MOAT Assessment
Eli Lilly has multiple structural moats: (1) Scaling manufacturing complexity — sterile fill-finish capacity for auto-injectors forms a substantial high-capex barrier to entry. (2) Patent portfolio and brand loyalty. (3) Switching costs for chronic metabolic therapies.

### Financial Quality
LLY generates best-in-class profitability, with TTM margins reaching 35.0% and strong return on capital. The balance sheet is healthy, supporting massive capacity expansion capex.

analyticsLog.marginAnchor: TTM 35.0% net margin used as anchor instead of 4-year average (21.6%). Margins are trending upwards: 15.36% (FY22) -> 23.51% (FY23) -> 31.67% (FY24) -> 34.99% TTM. Standard Rule #9 trending exception applies.
analyticsLog.growthDerivation: Consensus growth is 22.7% (blended 2-year average of Y1 30.8% and Y2 15.1%). Base CAGR 20% is within +-3pp of consensus.
dataQualityFlags: No anomalies detected in the raw financial statements.
TTM margin of 34.99% is structurally elevated relative to history, driven by GLP-1 product mix.
analyticsLog.confidenceBreakdown: 0.85/1.0 — Base 1.0. +0.10 for extreme structural moat in metabolic/GLP-1 scale and manufacturing complexity. -0.15 due to high regulatory drug pricing risks and intense biosimilar/competitor pipeline pressure.
